verdict.rationale: Omnara documents launching agents programmatically through its CLI, REST API and TypeScript SDK, so a pipeline could call it. But the evidence never mentions CI/CD integration, pipeline triggers, GitHub Actions, or fixing broken builds or failing tests. A generic launch API is a developer building block rather than the CI-triggered fix capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test
